ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) pixels occupying approximately 90-95% of the visible surface area, contrasted with isolated high-intensity (white) pixel clusters at the tips and scattered across the central surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The surface is characterized by a contiguous dark-pigmented field. High-contrast white pixel groups are concentrated at the lateral tips. Numerous small, punctate white spots are distributed across the lower half of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a narrow vertex angle and a depth roughly proportional to 1/15th of the total vertical height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Generally smooth trailing edge with low-frequency, low-amplitude undulations. One distinct medium-depth notch is visible on the left lobe's trailing edge halfway between the median notch and the tip. Distal tips show high-frequency, jagged pixel variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve extending from the median notch to the distal tips, with the left lobe exhibiting a slightly more pronounced upward sweep at the margin.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity white circular pixel formations are clearly visible on the far lateral margins of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of at least four parallel, light-grey linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are detected on the upper-left lobe, oriented diagonally from the trailing edge toward the fluke center.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white scarring and irregular tissue topography at the lateral tips of both lobes; visible parallel rake marks on the left lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly unique high-intensity white mark resembling the character '8' or 'B' is located in the lower-left quadrant of the fluke's ventral surface.
